RECOVERED means all target configuration effects are resolved safely; PARTIAL means some but not all. Cite only actual obs-N IDs. Incomplete evidence may require UNRESOLVED or ESCALATED. Patch only the relevant effect fields and obey current constraints; do not disable a dependency constraint to make recovery appear successful.
get_operation: {"operation_id":"..."} -> committed outcome.
record_recovery_audit: {"effect_ids":["recovery-operation-id"],"evidence_ids":["obs-N"]}.

The task supplies exact cross-resource safety predicates as a JSON expression tree. Honor all predicates after each recovery write. Evaluate ref, eq, ge, le, sum and implies according to the task expression_language. Only single-resource CAS is available. Read any resource listed in task.resource_ids as needed.
Additional strategy: inspect history completeness and field provenance before compensation, read all resources referenced by the declared predicates, evaluate the candidate inverse against those predicates, use conditional writes, honor the dependency order, and verify each resource separately. Stop safely when authority or evidence is incomplete. A successful CAS on one resource does not lock other resources.
